The actors behave like normal, rational individuals trying to work together to defeat the thing. The story line is engrossing and realistic. The dialogue is fun. The humor is on point. And the ending is something many continue to argue about.

When I was younger, I watched "A Nightmare On Elm Street" and laughed at it all the way through with my older brother. "The Thing" scared me so much, I had to sleep in my brother's bedroom that night on the floor.

I highly suggest you watch it. And I am a modern anti-movie person like you.
